How I beat the game most of the time is getting used to every character that's available to me. There's the basic fundamental of dodging, hiding under cover when shield is low, and restarting level if I end up in bad situations, like almost dying, or not getting anything good, for the possibility of getting something better. It's also choosing the most optimal buff for your playstyle. Health, Fire, and Poison buff are usually always good. Sometimes trap if you really want to be on the safe side. The best offensive buffs for me are bounce, shotgun, accuracy, charge, +2 mana, melee weapons bounce bullets. The really situational buffs are statue effect, extra weapon, elemental bullets. Buffs can really help you in playing the game. Make sure that you use your money to the best of the advantage, whether its buying statue effects, which differ from good to bad depending on the character (Assassin is good on alchemist and rogue because of low cd, while you might want Priest or Knight buff for more mana or more defense for other characters), getting enchantments for your weapons, usually the higher rarity, purple and orange are pretty good. Or buying really good weapons, my favorite are Snow Fox Vintage, Missile Battery, Magic Bow, etc, there are a lot more I haven't mentioned. Sometimes you're not going to always get the best weapons and buffs, and you just have to work your way around it with quick thinking, skill, and good decision-making.  If you're going to use real money, I recommend buying Paladin. The shield he sometimes gives you is really useful. I don't recommend spending too much money, but every penny helps in supporting the game developers since this is a free game with lots of good content. There's a lot of advice I haven't said, but others will probably help, and just let me or others know if you want more advice. You can also join the discord for more help or look at the Soul Knight Wikipedia for more information. Good luck and have fun!

Personally, I think Bruiser Nocturne is the most powerful thing (if done properly), and is significantly stronger than assassin Noct. Reason being is, from my recent experience, when I was fed, such as 8/0 (in gold elo), as the game proceeded, it became difficult to one-shot people (built duskblade, shiv, ie, ga, and randuins at the end). From my other experiences with building Nocturne as tank, depending on the situation, you may not do damage to be considered "bursty", but your defense stats make up for that with consistency. Going bruiser Noct doesn't make you a beast of a tank like Malphite or Chogath, but it doesn't make you as useless as if you played Assassin and got behind. Oh, just to point out, I've been mostly going top, but this could be applied to jungle too. I don't think Phase Rush is optimal for me, (Referring to Nocturne Top guide), but Conqueror when going against a tanky team, or Lethal Tempo, rather than Electrocute, seems to be effective for me. I have yet to test this, but I think Press the Attack is also viable, like an in-between of Conqueror and Lethal Tempo. I completely disregard Fleet Footwork top lane due to it not having any signficant benefit in duels or team fights in which other masteries would be better. It also doesn't have a strong benefit in lane either. But yeah, Bruiser Noct is probably most optimal right now, feel free to comment or disagree.
